verdict.rationale: The GST portal itself publishes task-oriented help: a step-by-step user manual on registration, quick videos for registration Parts A and B, 'learn how to' modules for returns, ITC, payments, refunds, appeals and notices, plus downloadable FAQs and manuals. The evidence is only page titles and link text, so whether the content is truly plain-language for a non-lawyer is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of the explainers' actual plain-language content and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration that founders can follow them, and step-by-step manuals evidenced beyond registration.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
